text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's summer vacation! ♪ What, you<n>think I'm not
going to train? Of<n>course, I am! Train hard, play
hard!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's that I sense watching<n>me from up in
trees? Is it some kind<n>of critter? Or perhaps...
